question: Which of the following comes under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Mines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Mines was** established in 1948**, primarily to promote the mining and mineral sector in India.
 
• The **headquarters of the Ministry of Mines is located in New Delhi.**
 
• As of 2024, the Ministry is headed by **Pralhad Joshi,** who took office in May 2019.
 
• The Ministry of Mines regulates the mining sector through laws such as the **Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coal** is a combustible black or brownish-black sedimentary rock formed from decomposed plant material, primarily composed of carbon along with hydrogen, sulfur, oxygen, and nitrogen.
 
• **Types of Coal**:
 
 
• **Anthracite**: The highest grade of coal with a high carbon content and energy output.
 
• **Bituminous**: A common type used for electricity generation and steel production.
 
• **Sub**-**bituminous**: Lower carbon content, used mainly for electricity generation.
 
• **Lignite**: The lowest grade, often referred to as brown coal, primarily used in electricity generation.
 
 
 
• **Natural gas** is a fossil fuel composed mainly of methane (CH₄) and is found in underground rock formations or associated with other fossil fuels.
 
• **Petroleum**, commonly known as crude oil, is a liquid fossil fuel composed mainly of hydrocarbons formed from the remains of ancient marine organisms.
 
• **Types of Petroleum:**
 
 
• **Light Crude Oil**: Less dense and easier to refine.
 
• **Heavy Crude Oil**: More viscous and difficult to extract and refine.
 
• **Sweet Crude Oil**: Low sulfur content, desirable for refining.
 
• **Sour Crude Oil**: High sulfur content, requires additional processing.
